ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40:60 ratio of high-intensity white to low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: The right lobe (viewer perspective) contains a large, contiguous high-intensity white geometric blob covering approximately 75% of its surface, bounded by dark speckling at the edges. The left lobe is dominated by low-intensity black pixels with high-contrast white mottling concentrated in the central and trailing-edge regions. A distinct dark vertical linear mark is located in the upper-mid section of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped central depression with an estimated pixel angle of 105 degrees and a moderate bounding-box depth relative to lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with varying pixel-amplitudes are present along the entire trailing edge. Deepest indentations are located near the lateral tips, particularly on the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex trajectory following a standard fluke curvature, with a sharp upward sweep towards the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast white pixel clusters consistent with barnacle growth are visible at the extreme distal tips of both lobes. Smaller, circular white spots are scattered across the dark-pigmented area of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A prominent, unaligned vertical linear pixel disruption is visible on the left lobe. Faint, dark horizontal linear markings are detectable on the white surface of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep vertical scar on the left lobe surface. Significant crustacean (barnacle) colonization present on the trailing edge tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced pigmentation asymmetry between the predominantly dark left lobe and the predominantly white right lobe.
